# Schema reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-schema-docs.mjs from schema/schema.graphql. Do not edit; run `npm run docs:schema`. -->

Every type and field below comes from `schema/schema.graphql`. `@neo4j/graphql` also generates queries, mutations, filters and sort inputs for each `@node` type (for example `movies`, `moviesConnection`, `createMovies`, `updateMovies`, `deleteMovies`); those are not listed here. See [mutations](mutations.md) and the live schema at `/graphql` for the generated parts.

## Movie

*node type (stored in Neo4j).* A film in the Movies graph.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String!` | Film title. Unique within the dataset. |
| `tagline` | `String` | Tagline shown on the poster. |
| `released` | `Int` | Year the film was released. |
| `rating` | `Float` | Audience rating from 0 to 10. Sample data, approximate. |
| `runtime` | `Int` | Running time in minutes. |
| `genres` | `[Genre!]!` | Genres the film belongs to. *(relationship `IN_GENRE` (OUT))* |
| `actors` | `[Person!]!` | People who acted in the film. *(relationship `ACTED_IN` (IN), properties `ActedIn`)* |
| `directors` | `[Person!]!` | People who directed the film. *(relationship `DIRECTED` (IN))* |
| `similar(limit: Int = 8)` | `[Movie!]!` | Films most like this one, best match first. Scored by shared director (3 points), shared cast member (2) and shared genre (1). Argument `limit`: Maximum number of films to return. *(computed by a `@cypher` statement (see below))* |

## Person

*node type (stored in Neo4j).* A person who acted in or directed films.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `String!` | Full name. Unique within the dataset. |
| `born` | `Int` | Year the person was born. Only known for some people. |
| `actedCount` | `Int` | Number of films the person acted in. Stored on the node and recalculated by the server after every mutation. |
| `directedCount` | `Int` | Number of films the person directed. Stored on the node and recalculated by the server after every mutation. |
| `actedIn` | `[Movie!]!` | Films the person acted in. *(relationship `ACTED_IN` (OUT), properties `ActedIn`)* |
| `directed` | `[Movie!]!` | Films the person directed. *(relationship `DIRECTED` (OUT))* |
| `collaborators(limit: Int = 8)` | `[Collaboration!]!` | People this person has worked with most, ranked by number of shared films (acting or directing). Argument `limit`: Maximum number of collaborators to return. *(computed by a `@cypher` statement (see below))* |

## Collaboration

*plain object type.* A person someone has worked with, and how many films they share.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `String!` | Name of the collaborator. Look the person up by this name. |
| `films` | `Int!` | Number of films the two people worked on together. |

## Genre

*node type (stored in Neo4j).* A film genre.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `String!` | Genre name, for example Drama. |
| `movies` | `[Movie!]!` | Films in this genre. *(relationship `IN_GENRE` (IN))* |

## ActedIn

*relationship properties.* Properties on the ACTED_IN relationship.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `roles` | `[String!]!` | Character names played in the film. |

## Computed fields (`@cypher`)

These fields run a Cypher statement on request, so they always reflect the current graph.

### `Movie.similar`

```cypher
MATCH (this)-[r1:IN_GENRE|ACTED_IN|DIRECTED]-(shared)-[r2:IN_GENRE|ACTED_IN|DIRECTED]-(other:Movie)
WHERE other <> this AND type(r1) = type(r2)
WITH other, sum(CASE type(r1) WHEN 'DIRECTED' THEN 3 WHEN 'ACTED_IN' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS score
ORDER BY score DESC, other.rating DESC, other.title
RETURN other LIMIT $limit
```

### `Person.collaborators`

```cypher
MATCH (this)-[:ACTED_IN|DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN|DIRECTED]-(other:Person)
WHERE other <> this
WITH other, count(DISTINCT m) AS films
ORDER BY films DESC, other.name
LIMIT $limit
RETURN {name: other.name, films: films} AS result
```
